prompt:
Fix snippets/event-ticket-status.liquid so it renders a ticket status badge. Input: one top-level variable `ticket`, an object that is never null. It has these fields: - `ticket.holder`: string or null. The ticket holder's name. - `ticket.refunded`: boolean. - `ticket.cancelled`: boolean. - `ticket.checked_in`: boolean. - `ticket.event_ended`: boolean. Several flags can be true at the same time. The status is decided by the first matching rule in this priority order: 1. `refunded` is true: key `refunded`, label `Refunded`. 2. `cancelled` is true: key `cancelled`, label `Cancelled`. 3. `checked_in` is true: key `checked-in`, label `Checked in`. 4. `event_ended` is true: key `expired`, label `Expired`. 5. Otherwise: key `valid`, label `Valid`. The output is exactly: `
LABELHOLDER
` HOLDER is determined as follows: - Take `ticket.holder` and remove leading and trailing whitespace. - If the holder is null, or is empty after stripping, HOLDER is empty. - If the final status is not `valid` or `checked-in`, HOLDER is empty. - Otherwise HOLDER is `NAME`. NAME is the stripped holder, HTML-escaped with the `escape` filter, so `&`, `<`, `>` and `"` become entities. There must be no whitespace or newlines between tags, and none before or after the output. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/event-ticket-status.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
